note: Moves the free squad feeds have not caught up with, laid over the harvested squads by build_pl_data.apply_transfers. The overlay WINS here — unlike appointments.json, where the harvest wins — because this is a person who has read the news and the feed is the one lagging. Every entry is deleted once the feed agrees; the build prints REDUNDANT when that has happened.

transfers.source: reported by the desk owner. NOT yet in the FPL bootstrap feed: the 22 August refresh read 600 players across 20 clubs, retired the 43 the feed no longer carried, and kept Romero at Tottenham.
transfers.why_null: The departure was reported without a destination. `to: null` means only that he is no longer in this division, which is what is actually known — naming a club would be a guess, and a guess here prices another club's fixtures off his card rate. If he has in fact joined a Premier League club, set `to` to that club's code and his rate travels with him.
